Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt\"}", "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_chars\":300,\"max_overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].chunks() as Any)
```
